---
title: "jira.psom_comment"
description: "Every comment on every PSOM ticket, one row per comment per snapshot."
---

Every comment on every PSOM ticket, one row per comment per snapshot.

Each row is one comment on one ticket (`key`) as it stood on one snapshot
`date`. Join to [`psom`](psom.qmd) on `key` and `date`.

`Keywords`: jira, psom, comments, internal notes, replies, support

## Provenance

Written by the `psom-sync` Lambda in the same run as [`psom`](psom.qmd), from each
ticket's full comment history. Snapshots before 2026-09-29 were backfilled from
the JSON `comments` column that `psom` used to carry.

* **Updated**: Daily, at ~06:00 ET
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Yinlin Zhang](mailto:yinlin.zhang@cds-snc.ca) (Data and Research team)

## Fields

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| date | varchar | Partition key: the date the Lambda ran (`YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| key | varchar | Jira ticket key, e.g. `PSOM-42`. |
| comment_id | varchar | Jira's ID for the comment. Null before 2026-09-29. |
| author | varchar | Display name of the comment's author. |
| created | varchar | ISO 8601 timestamp when the comment was posted, e.g. `2026-07-02T08:32:40.494-0400`. |
| updated | varchar | ISO 8601 timestamp when the comment was last edited. Equals `created` if never edited. |
| body | varchar | The comment text, extracted from Atlassian Document Format (ADF) to plain text. |
| internal | boolean | Is the comment a JSM internal note, hidden from the customer? `false` means a public reply. |
| fetched_at | varchar | UTC timestamp when the Lambda wrote this row (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`). |

## Notes

**Every snapshot repeats every comment.** Like `psom`, each partition holds the
full comment history of every ticket still in the project, so a comment appears
once per snapshot. Filter to one `date` before counting. Comments on archived
tickets drop out along with the ticket (see [`psom`](psom.qmd)).

**Backfilled history (through 2026-09-28).** Snapshots are daily from
2026-09-29. Before that they were weekly, on Mondays. In the backfilled
snapshots, `comment_id` is null. To match a comment across them, use `key`,
`author` and `created`.
